pipelines.name: ORB
pipelines.settings: CUDA ORB; up to 500 features; scale factor 1.2; up to 8 pyramid levels; FAST threshold 20; Hamming distance with cross-check.

pipelines.name: SIFT
pipelines.settings: GPU SIFT; up to 8192 features; octave resolution 3; peak threshold 0.0066667; RootSIFT; ratio 0.8, maximum distance 0.7, cross-check.

pipelines.name: SuperPoint+SuperGlue
pipelines.settings: SuperPoint threshold 0.005, NMS radius 4, no feature cap; SuperGlue outdoor weights, 20 Sinkhorn iterations, matching threshold 0.2.

pipelines.name: SuperPoint+LightGlue
pipelines.settings: SuperPoint threshold 0.0005, NMS radius 4, no feature cap; LightGlue threshold 0.1, depth confidence 0.95, width confidence 0.99; Flash disabled.

pipelines.name: LoFTR
pipelines.settings: Outdoor dual-softmax weights; coarse threshold 0.2; grayscale conversion and internal crop to a multiple of 8.

pipelines.name: ELoFTR
pipelines.settings: Outdoor weights; coarse threshold 0.1; internal linear interpolation and multiple-of-32 dimensions; no square padding; RepVGG inference conversion.

pipelines.name: MatchAnything (ELoFTR)
pipelines.settings: ELoFTR-based public weights; coarse threshold 0.1; LANCZOS interpolation and multiple-of-32 dimensions; no square padding or RepVGG conversion; author MTD_SPVS candidate selection; strict weight loading.

pipelines.name: DKM
pipelines.settings: DKMv3 outdoor; threshold-balanced sampling of 10,000 correspondences, threshold 0.05; Gaussian-process solve remains FP32 in mixed precision.

pipelines.name: MASt3R
pipelines.settings: Public ViTLarge 512 metric weights; dot-product reciprocal nearest-neighbor matching, stride 8, at most 10 iterations, 3-pixel border exclusion; no added confidence threshold.
